ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a phase diagram with vertical axis P and horizontal axis T. Point A is located at the intersection of three boundary curves; the curve segment extending from A toward the lower left to C is labeled AC; the curve segment extending from A toward the upper right to B is labeled AB; the curve segment extending from A upward to D is labeled AD. Reasoning: The three phase boundary lines intersect at A, and A is the triple point. Solid and gas equilibrium corresponds to the sublimation curve, which on a phase diagram is the boundary line from the triple point toward lower temperature and lower pressure. In the figure, the line segment extending from A toward lower T and lower P is AC. Therefore AC should be filled in.

method.method_draft: From the diagram, locate the triple point A where the three boundaries meet. Identify the boundary that leaves A toward lower pressure and lower temperature, since that is the solid-gas sublimation equilibrium line. The segment with those endpoints is AC, so fill in AC.
